title: events/types/mutation.promoted
description: Payload for event_type 'mutation.promoted' (feature 016; FR-1408/1410): a pending candidate passed boundary re-validation and was installed over the target pack file at run start, before any dispatch. Scored-episode immutability preserved — promotion never lands mid-run.

pack_hash.description: Canonical hash of the installed pack — the run's new revision identity.

parent_hash.description: Hash of the pack content this promotion replaced (rollback lineage).

episode_boundary.description: Must be true; mid-run promotion is a contract violation.

baseline_score.description: improve.score of the episode that produced the candidate — the regression baseline.
